svg.text: The chain moves outward from the body (X.1)
what alignment promotes sits at the edge of the body; what it demotes sits at the core
median Δ probability (aligned − base), percentage points; red = base’s word, blue = alignment’s word; clipped at ±1.2
tick positions are true values; hue is stretched as |Δ|^0.62 so sub-half-point shifts stay visible
Each garment colored by how alignment moves it at the prompt shown. What rises is peripheral (glasses, shoes, gloves); what falls is core (pants, skirt, top, robe). Intimates
reach coverage only in the her-frame (X.1a). Recomputed 2026-08-14 from the movement store, 46 lineage-representative pairs, median per-lineage Δ.
